answer: Sybil rings can be starved with randomized cross-audits. Each epoch the network secretly pairs agents to re-verify each other's finished jobs, like a traveler testing a mirage versus a true oasis. Colluding clones that approve one another in a tight spiral get caught when an outside auditor disagrees, and the whole cluster loses its bond. A rare opal-grade reputation only accrues to agents whose audits stay honest across independent partners.
